task_summary: Customer reports that the Artisan Crystal Vase from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged due to shipping. The proper resolution is the shipping-damage process: review shipping and return policies, issue a refund to the original payment method, provide a return label, and apply a separate fragile-item goodwill credit if the item qualifies as fragile.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must issue the separate $10 fragile-item goodwill credit to original payment.

opening_message: Hi, my order ORD-6023 with the Artisan Crystal Vase arrived damaged. The box was crushed, and the vase is broken.
